about.summary: A dashboard example: in an uptrend (above the 50-day average), buy when Stochastic RSI turns up from oversold; take profit at +10% or when it turns down from overbought, with a stop 2 ATRs below entry.
about.why: Uses Stochastic RSI, introduced by Chande & Kroll, to time pullbacks, and Wilder's ATR to size the stop to the stock's normal daily movement, a practice taught widely (including by the Turtles). Not a published system.
about.caveats: Made for this dashboard as a teaching example and not tested in any publication.
references: Chande, T. S., & Kroll, S. (1994). The New Technical Trader. Wiley.
Wilder, J. W. (1978). New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems. Trend Research.
Faith, C. (2007). Way of the Turtle. McGraw-Hill.
